# origincloud_compute_instance (Resource)

A virtual machine in one zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "origincloud_compute_key_pair" "admin" {
  project = "my-project-123"
}

# Launched from its own arguments.
resource "origincloud_compute_instance" "web" {
  project            = "my-project-123"
  zone               = "eu-central1-az1"
  instance_type      = "//compute.origincloudapis.eu/instanceTypes/gp1.core.2"
  image_family       = "//compute.origincloudapis.eu/imageFamilies/ubuntu-24-04-minimal"
  key_pair           = origincloud_compute_key_pair.admin.id
  network_interfaces = ["//network.origincloudapis.eu/projects/my-project-123/zones/eu-central1-az1/networkInterfaces/eni-1a2b3c"]
  tags               = { "origin:name" = "web" }
}

# Launched from version 1 of a launch template, with its own tags over the
# version's. `@default` and `@latest` name the template's default and newest
# version; a bare name is its default.
resource "origincloud_compute_launch_template" "web" {
  project = "my-project-123"
  launch_template_data = {
    instance_type = "//compute.origincloudapis.eu/instanceTypes/gp1.core.2"
    image_family  = "//compute.origincloudapis.eu/imageFamilies/ubuntu-24-04-minimal"
    key_pair      = origincloud_compute_key_pair.admin.id
  }
}

resource "origincloud_compute_instance" "from_template" {
  project            = "my-project-123"
  zone               = "eu-central1-az1"
  launch_template    = "${origincloud_compute_launch_template.web.id}@1"
  network_interfaces = ["//network.origincloudapis.eu/projects/my-project-123/zones/eu-central1-az1/networkInterfaces/eni-4d5e6f"]
  tags               = { "origin:name" = "from-template" }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project the instance is in. Changing it replaces the instance.
- `zone` (String) The zone the instance is in. Changing it replaces the instance.

### Optional

- `boot_volume` (Attributes) The boot volume: its size and storage class at launch, and the volume. The image's size on the default storage class when left out. Changing it replaces the instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--boot_volume))
- `image` (String) The full name of the image the boot volume is created from, in the instance's zone: one of the project's own, `//compute.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/images/{image}`, or a public one, `//compute.origincloudapis.eu/zones/{zone}/images/{image}`. Set exactly one of `image` and `image_family`; launched from a family, this is the public image the family resolved to. Changing it replaces the instance.
- `image_family` (String) The full name of the image family to launch the current public image of, `//compute.origincloudapis.eu/imageFamilies/{image_family}`. Set exactly one of `image` and `image_family`. Empty when the instance was launched from an image. Changing it replaces the instance.
- `instance_type` (String) The instance type by its full name, `//compute.origincloudapis.eu/instanceTypes/{instance_type}`, such as `//compute.origincloudapis.eu/instanceTypes/gp1.core.2`: one whose `available` is true. Changing it needs the instance `STOPPED`. Required unless `launch_template` is set; left out, it is the template's.
- `key_pair` (String) The full name of the key pair whose public key is installed for `login_user`, in the instance's project. Changing it replaces the instance. Required unless `launch_template` is set; left out, it is the template's.
- `launch_template` (String) The full name of the launch template version the instance was launched from, `//compute.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/launchTemplates/{launch_template}@{version}`, with the number the launch resolved `@default` or `@latest` to. Empty for an instance launched without a template. The template may since have been changed or deleted. Set it to launch the instance from a template: `//compute.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/launchTemplates/{launch_template}` for its default version, or with `@{version}`, `@default` or `@latest` after it for that version. The arguments set with it override the version's for this launch only. The state keeps what was configured while the template is the one launched from.
- `local_disks` (Attributes List) Disks on the machine the instance runs on, beside its boot volume, created blank at launch; at most 16. A local disk is temporary: it comes back empty after every stop and start and after its machine restarts, and it is deleted with the instance. It can't be the boot disk, snapshotted, resized or detached, and an instance with one isn't moved to another machine while it runs. Each appears among the instance's volume attachments. Changing it replaces the instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--local_disks))
- `login_user` (String) The account to log in as: a user created at first boot that holds the key pair. A POSIX user name of at most 32 lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, starting with a letter or an underscore, and not `root`. The image's `default_user` when left empty. Changing it replaces the instance.
- `network_interfaces` (List of String) The network interfaces' full names, in device order, the boot interface first; exactly one today. Each is an existing interface in the instance's project and zone that nothing else holds, created with the network service: its subnet and security groups are the instance's. Terminating the instance releases it, and it stays. An instance launched from a recipe with an interface spec, or before interfaces were named at launch, shows the interface created for it once it exists, which is deleted with the instance. Changing it replaces the instance. Required unless `launch_template` is set; left out, it is the template's.
- `service_account` (String) The full name of the service account the instance runs as, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}`: a `WORKLOAD` service account of the instance's organization that isn't deleted. Launching with one, or updating the instance to one, needs `iam.service_account.act_as` on the organization as well; an update that leaves it empty removes it, and a terminated instance's can't change. Empty for an instance that runs as none. Left out, it keeps its current value, the template's when launched from one; set it empty to clear it.
- `tags` (Map of String) Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows. Left out, it keeps its current value, the template's when launched from one; set it empty to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the instance was launched. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) The principal that launched the instance, by its full name on iam: `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/users/{user}`, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}`, or a platform service agent's or service's name when the platform did.
- `health` (Attributes) Whether the platform can currently confirm the instance is working, which `state` doesn't say: a `RUNNING` instance on a machine that stopped answering is still `RUNNING`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health))
- `id` (String) The instance's full resource name, `//compute.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/instances/{instance}`: what an argument that refers to the instance takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `interface_addresses` (Attributes List) Each network interface's private addresses, in the order of `network_interfaces`; an interface not attached yet has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interface_addresses))
- `name` (String) The instance's resource name.
- `state` (String) Where the instance is in its lifecycle. One of `INITIALIZING`, `PENDING`, `RUNNING`, `STOPPING`, `STOPPED`, `SHUTTING_DOWN`, `TERMINATED`, `FAILED`.
- `state_reason` (String) Why the instance is `FAILED`, or why a `STOPPED` instance went down when the machine it ran on failed; empty otherwise.

<a id="nestedatt--boot_volume"></a>
### Nested Schema for `boot_volume`

Optional:

- `size_gib` (Number) The size in GiB the volume was created with, at least the image's size; the image's size when left at 0. Grow the volume itself to resize it; this keeps the size at launch.
- `storage_class` (String) The storage class by its full name, `//pvs.origincloudapis.eu/storageClasses/{storage_class}`; the default class when left empty.

Read-Only:

- `volume` (String) The volume's full name, in the instance's project and zone.


<a id="nestedatt--local_disks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `local_disks`

Required:

- `size_gib` (Number) The size in GiB, at least 1.

Optional:

- `device` (String) The device name the guest sees the disk under, `vda` to `vdz` but `vdc`, and none the boot volume or another local disk has. The first free one, in the order the disks are listed, when left empty.


<a id="nestedatt--health"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health`

Read-Only:

- `availability` (String) The summary of `checks`, for a listing that shows one value per instance. Only the checks say whether a problem is the platform's or the instance's own. One of `AVAILABLE`, `IMPAIRED`, `UNKNOWN`, `NOT_APPLICABLE`.
- `checks` (Attributes List) Every check, always all of them: one with nothing to report is `NOT_APPLICABLE` or `INSUFFICIENT_DATA`, never left out. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health--checks))

<a id="nestedatt--health--checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health.checks`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Whose the subject is, derived from `kind`. One of `SYSTEM`, `INSTANCE`.
- `change_time` (String) When the check came to `outcome`; empty while nothing has observed it. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `kind` (String) What the check observes. One of `HOST_REACHABLE`, `DOMAIN_STATE`, `NETWORK_REACHABLE`, `GUEST_AGENT`, `GUEST_PRESENT`.
- `outcome` (String) Its outcome. One of `OK`, `IMPAIRED`, `INSUFFICIENT_DATA`, `NOT_APPLICABLE`.



<a id="nestedatt--interface_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interface_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `ipv4_address` (String) Its private IPv4 address.
- `ipv6_address` (String) Its IPv6 address.
- `network_interface` (String) The network interface's full name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An instance is imported by its full resource name, or its relative one.
terraform import origincloud_compute_instance.web //compute.origincloudapis.eu/projects/my-project-123/zones/eu-central1-az1/instances/i-1a2b3c
```
